title: FinOps cost management
description: For a change that adds or scales cloud or AI usage: costs allocated to an owner, a unit metric and an alert on unexpected spend.

rules.instruction: Tag new cloud resources with the owner, product and environment keys of the project's allocation policy (FinOps Allocation).
rules.verification: Check the infrastructure code or the billing export for the allocation tags on each new resource.

rules.instruction: Before release, estimate the monthly cost of running the change and ask the finance owner to approve it against the budget.
rules.verification: Link the estimate and the finance owner's recorded approval from the change.

rules.instruction: Ask the finance owner which unit metric the change should report, such as cost per active customer (FinOps Unit Economics).
rules.verification: Check that the cost report or dashboard shows the unit metric with its data source.

rules.instruction: Configure a budget or anomaly alert for the new resources and route it to the cost owner (FinOps Anomaly Management).
rules.verification: Check the alert configuration and its recipient.
